name: JWT Auth Interceptor
description: Intercepts outgoing HTTP requests to a-console (OMATE_CONSOLE_URL), injects Authorization: Bearer header, and provides a structured a-console API client with auto-login for other plugins.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 拦截发往 a-console（OMATE_CONSOLE_URL）的 HTTP 请求并注入 JWT 认证头；同时提供结构化的 a-console API 客户端（支持自动登录），供其他插件直接调用。
description_i18n.en-US: Intercepts outgoing HTTP requests to a-console (OMATE_CONSOLE_URL), injects Authorization: Bearer header, and provides a structured a-console API client with auto-login for other plugins.

author: Qoder

env.OMATE_USER_TOKEN: JWT token for Authorization header. Required.
